description: DISCLAIMER: I am using Strava because I did not bring my watch or any running stuff with me to Chicago!!!!! woke up this morning in Sarah’s guest bed after some wine & reminiscing last night with her & Rachel. Literally the best sleep I can remember. May just buy the same mattress. I opened my eyes really early & I think the first thing I saw was the sky out Sarah’s windows (grey but peaceful) & the first thing I thought about was how sweaty I was. I stayed in bed & went back to sleep until around 9:30 when I went down for coffee & decided to go on a run. I started by heading to the 10 mile path & I was listening to sweet Mac miller (senior skip day duh) & tan along there. THE EYES UP THING I WROTE IN CHALK THE SUMMER BEFORE SENIOR YEAR IS STILL THERE. LIKE WHAT. That made me really nostalgic. But not in the way that I wanna go back but just in the way that everything in life is really special. I turned around at the 6miler mark then headed back towards NCC. I got to the parking lot (short cut way) & headed back towards prairie to see it & my old house. When I was running by my old house I saw Dennis (old neighbor who had a crush on my mom) out mowing the lawn. I waved to him & he acknowledged but I don’t think he recognized me because I haven’t seen him since middle school aside from once in einsteins bagels where he paid for my food (probably to get to my mom HAHA). I wish I would have stopped & talked to him but I had places to be. Ended the run going through dunrobin. Very tired at the end but so glad I did it. Shoutout Sarah for the shorts. Now I am going to go do abs(?)
column5: & get ready to go ape shit on some wine this weekend. Love you guys dearly!

description: Was aiming for 7:50 scared of going too slow so I went too fast. It looked like it was gonna be 8 min miles at first

Using strava to make sure I get my mileage. For some reason (probs bc I don’t have a brain) I thought the group run was at 6am??????? Literally never has been & I’ve been every week since May????? Like what was I thinking????? So I got up superrrrr early to do the extra 7 miles to get to 16 & I got back to my house to get ready to run to comeback when I realized it was 5:50 & the run was at 7. I went up. brushed out my rat tail to save me some trouble later. and headed back out along the same route to get mileage until it was time to head to comeback. The run was actually incredible but I am just kinda left dumbfounded with how ridiculously stupid I can be. Alas. I kinda liked it & may do the same thing next long run. Feels good to be done so early & get to run my own pace & listen to music.   Goal paces: 8:55 for mile 1 7:55 for 2-5 8:55 5-8 7:55 8-12 8:55 12-16  I need to do better paying attention to that & how it’s supposed to feel. I felt amazing up until mile 14 when I turned to head home after meeting up w run cronies. Then my calves started to feel it & I felt heavy & slow the whole way home. That’s why I need to pace better!!!! I thought I was gonna die in the shower because my calves were so tight & tired. Damn near pulled a Julia O’Dekirk & sat down. Miss you Julia. Love that name.  Now I am sitting on the couch gonna watch a bunch of movies until I take a nap. elevating my feet. I watched Mr & Mrs smith last night. Soooooo good. Different than I expected. ***SPOILER ALERT*** I was starting to get really frustrated with Angelina for trying to kill Brad when they obvi could just be together. Worked out in the end though. Felt great to not wake up hungover today. Love you all dearly!
